description: This file defines a React functional component named Alert, which displays an alert box with different types (info, success, warning, error). It includes icons, styling, dismissible functionality, and animations, serving as a reusable UI component for notifications or alerts within a React project.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: React functional component that renders an alert box with customizable type, title, children, dismissible option, and animation. Manages visibility state and handles dismissal with optional animation delay.
